changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'IssueType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[IssueType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [IsSystem] [bit] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IssueType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IssueType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [CONST_IssueType_Name] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Name] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IssueType_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IssueType_Uid] ON [dbo].[IssueType] ([Uid]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IssueType_Uid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_IssueType_Uid] ON [dbo].[IssueType] END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[IssueType_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[IssueType] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Delete', [queue].WriteIndexXml('Removed', 'IssueType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'IssueType', ID from deleted END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[IssueType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[IssueType] FOR INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IssueType', ID, UpdatedBy), 'IssueType', ID from inserted; END
